script.source: Shipped GOB 9 and tempmods.py specify EnergizedAttacksInit, EnergizedAttacksTerm, and PlayEnergizedFX at one second when in combat. general.py rejects the concurrent opposite toggle and shipped STA 0xc6001a9f provides the message.
script.runtime: AbilityBuffs tracks the live toggle, CombatTactics.Type selects it for the actual round and ranged consumers, and AwakenedTacticalToggles drives the guarded recurring self and watcher FX and localized refusal.
script.test: ability-parity-awakened-tactical-toggles disposable full 80 b9 activation sends the switch, repeated self/watcher FX, opposite attempt refusal, switch off and no post-removal FX. AbilityBuffTests.AwakenedToggleChangesRealDamageAndContestUntilRemoval exercises exact live-toggle selection through close-combat damage, roll and Free Attack damage, refusal and restoration. The disposable checks exactly one refusal acknowledgement, one shipped localized record, zero extra chat records and a subsequent pulse from the retained tactic.
